content: The composite Protect Lamp shall be set to Lamp Off in case the Indicator referenced by DemProtectLampIndicatorRef has an IndicatorStatus DEM_INDICATOR_OFF . All other IndicatorStatus states than DEM_INDICATOR_OFF shall set the composite Protect Lamp to Lamp On.
